chapter_note: The oldest teaching substrate here is the astrological-cosmological mechanism explaining changing human stature/longevity via a fivefold hierarchy of zodiacal time-authorities (year/month/day/hour/moment) (¶2–6). Dialogue attributions are later frame (¶1, ¶8, ¶12) and are stripped where they introduce otherwise core material (¶3, ¶10). The second half shows clear editorial fatigue: a homiletic/end-times application and moralizing critique of contemporary humans (¶7, ¶11) plus renewed Q&A framing (¶8–9).

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic dialogue setup ("Once again", catechumen questioning "the enlightener"), with honorific address; functions as hagiographic/Q&A container rather than teaching substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, no[te] that Adam is mighty in his stature, and great is his size. Even his years are many! He spent many years living in the world. And he is not the only one we have found to be mighty; but all the others who were begotten in his generation, many are their years too. Still, these people who are born today, their stature has been diminished in power; even their years are lessened. Also, why is the birth today, of [the]y who are born, altered compared with that of these first [ ... ] place to place? See, even the stars and signs of the zodiac continue in their positions. Why now have the age and the years of these last ones diminished, and he has also become smaller, compared to these ancient ones who belong to these first generations?
paragraphs.temporal_note: Introduces the problem in cosmological terms (stars/zodiac as stable determinants). Although it uses present-time comparison (“today/now”), it stays within a cosmic-astrological explanatory frame rather than institutional/pastoral application.

paragraphs.core_text: They increased, have turned, and diminished; because there are five types of authorities and leaders appointed in the sphere of zodiacal signs, and the heavens above it. They have names they are ca[lled] by: the first name is the year; the sec[on]d is the month; the third is the day; the fou[rth] is the hour; the fifth is the moment. Now, these five positions, and these five houses, exist in the sphere and the heavens. These places have five powers, and they are made masters over them. The master of the year exists; the master of the month exists; the master of the day exists; the master of the hour exists; the master of the moment exists. In turn one is above his companion; and in turn the one above is made the master over the one below him.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution and hagiographic praise: “And for his part our enlightener, in his deep wisdom and his great understanding, speaks to this catechumen who had questioned him:” — a later framing layer introducing otherwise systematic fivefold teaching.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core content is a systematic fivefold hierarchy (year/month/day/hour/moment) mapped to ‘masters’ within the zodiac/heavens—classic substrate-style degree structure. The removed opening is a clear compilation frame marker ("our enlightener" + encomium).

paragraphs.core_text: So, mankind is begotten, and [the ani]mals. They are born in these powers. And, thus, these powers have received authority since the beginning of creation till the end of the world. Now, in the beginning of the generations the powers who were masters over the years reigned. Therefore, because of this, the offspring born in their generations and their lifetime: their years were found to be greater. They attain a long life span in the generation of Adam, and [tha]t of Sethel his son, and that of the ones who came after him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the impersonal mechanism: beings are ‘born in these powers’; longevity varies by which temporal power rules. Remains cosmos→cosmos (heavens/zodiac/time-powers → human lifespan), without institutional targeting.

paragraphs.core_text: After they ceased to reign, namely the powers who are masters over the years; the powers who are masters over the months themselves reigned. Like the months, for they are less than the years; again this [is] also the case with the offspring w[ho were] born in them. Their life span is less [than the life span of the ones born] in the generation of the powers who master the years!
paragraphs.temporal_note: Iterative degree-descent logic (year→month) applied to lifespan; characteristic schematic exposition of the substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: When the authority of the powers who master the months was completed; the powers of the days received authority after them. Therefore, like the days, for they are less than the months, this also is the case with the offspring who were born in them. Their life span is less than the life span of the ones born in the powers who are masters over the months. Again, even so the offspring who were born in the hours, and of the moments. Their conduit is less than that of the months and the days.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the fivefold cascade (months→days→hours→moments) in a purely structural way; no citation, exhortation, or institutional application.

Homiletic/application turn: direct address (“Do you see”), end-times imminence, and generalized ‘today’ moralizing. Even though it uses cosmological language (‘life and light in the world’), the paragraph functions as an exhortative lesson rather than the schematic substrate.
Renewed Q&A framing with entreaty and summary back to the teacher; strongly formulaic (‘Once again’, ‘I entreat you, my master!’).
A transition question in the catechumen’s voice (no mechanism given), serving the dialogue progression rather than preserving a self-standing schematic teaching unit.

paragraphs.core_text: For the manner of these first generations is that they are richer in their light and purer in stature. Even their years are greater. Thus, again, even their offspring is much more than the offspring of this tim[e]. They were spending a longer time [ ... ] in [the w]omb of their mother. Afterwards, they [ ... ] a number in a single womb. There are times five were brought forth from a single womb, and times six were brought forth from [a] single womb! There are some lesser than this; again, some greater than this. Indeed, because of this the offspring of Eve multiplied, and of her children. The earth was filled by reason of them alone; because the offspring from the generation of the people of old, who they bore into the world, differ greatly from those of today. Their conception and their birth is not like latter births, brought forth nowadays from the woman's uterus.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution and introductory exhortation: “The enlightener speaks to that catechumen: While well do you ask for this lesson, so yet know and understand it!” — later frame + audience-address overlaying the teaching.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Underlying content gives a causal account rooted in ‘light’ quantity and embodied condition (purer stature → greater fertility), still within the cosmological system; the stripped opening is explicit pedagogical framing with imperative address.
Ethical/moralizing denunciation of contemporary humans (‘wickedness’, ‘evil’, ‘ugly’, ‘death catches them’) without a new cosmological mechanism; fits later pastoral-application register.
Closing homage/thanksgiving formula to the teacher; classic hagiographic frame concluding the unit.
